identity.name: Black Bay 54
identity.one_liner: The smallest current Black Bay at 37mm, referencing the 1954 Oyster Prince Submariner, Tudor's first diver, with no crown guards on the case.

narrative.story: Tudor introduced the Black Bay 54 in 2023 as a smaller, more historically faithful alternative to the Black Bay Fifty-Eight, dropping the case to 37mm and removing crown guards entirely to match the proportions of Tudor's first Submariner-type diver from 1954. It uses the same MT5400 movement family as the Pelagos 39.
narrative.collector_notes: The lack of crown guards and the smaller 37mm case make this sit noticeably closer to 1950s wrist presence than the Fifty-Eight, which buyers coming from a 39-41mm Black Bay should try on before ordering rather than judge by the diameter number alone.
